title.zh: 卷一百〇八 載記第八 慕容廆

proposal.reason: The displayed Chinese reads 廆, Hui, and 首服 supports confessed; the alternate digital transcription is noted separately.

context.zh: 會三國使亦至請和，曰：「非我本意也，崔平州教我耳。」
context.idiomatic: The allied envoys blamed Pingzhou inspector Cui Bi, saying, "This was never our intent—Inspector Cui Pingzhou urged us."
context.literal: When envoys from all three states also arrived suing for peace they said, "This was never our intent—Inspector Cui Pingzhou urged us."

context.zh: 廆將燾示以攻圍之處，臨之以兵，曰：「汝叔父教三國滅我，何以詐來賀我乎？」
context.idiomatic: Hui trapped Tao and said, "Your uncle taught three states to destroy me—why pretend congratulations?"
context.literal: Hui showed Tao the siege lines and ringed him with troops: "Your uncle taught three states to destroy me—why pretend congratulations?"

context.zh: 廆乃遣燾歸說毖曰：「降者上策，走者下策也。」
context.idiomatic: Hui offered surrender or flight, saying, "Surrender is the best plan; flight the worst."
context.literal: Hui sent Tao back to persuade Bi: "Surrender is the best plan; flight the worst."
